svg.title: You press it. Sysvia confirms it.
svg.desc: The actual Sysvia shortcut confirmation is shown over a native Windows desktop, with an enlarged view beside it. Ctrl + Alt + G turns Game mode on and off. Captures preserve the shipping switch transition; confirmations disappear after two seconds. Reduced motion shows the settled on state.
svg.text: You press it. Sysvia confirms it.
The same switch as Settings. A clear answer, then it fades away.
Change your shortcuts or turn confirmations off in Settings → Shortcuts.
Captured from the v2.3.6 release package. Confirmation enlarged at right.
